title: Jimmy Kimmel Recaps Trump’s ‘Big Dim Summit’
summary: “My God, even if you voted for this guy, you have to admit, he has the worst taste in friends,” the late night host said of Trump’s chummy meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin.
